name: Exotics Share of Total Kalshi Volume (Monthly
query_sql:
WITH src AS (
    SELECT
        date_trunc('month', week) AS month,
        category,
        CAST("Volume" AS DOUBLE) AS volume
    FROM query_5910819
),
monthly AS (
    SELECT
        month,
        SUM(volume) FILTER (WHERE category = 'Exotics') AS exotics_vol,
        SUM(volume) FILTER (WHERE category = 'Sports')  AS sports_vol,
        SUM(volume)                                     AS kalshi_vol
    FROM src
    GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT
    exotics_vol,
    sports_vol,
    kalshi_vol,
    100.0 * exotics_vol / NULLIF(kalshi_vol, 0) AS exotics_pct_of_kalshi,
    100.0 * exotics_vol / NULLIF(sports_vol, 0) AS exotics_pct_of_sports
FROM monthly
WHERE month = (SELECT MAX(month) FROM monthly)
